intro: We list {{count}} MBA / PGDM colleges in Maharashtra where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh. Most are in Mumbai, with two in Pune and IIM Nagpur in Nagpur.

These MBA colleges in Maharashtra with ₹50 lakh highest package include IIT Bombay, SPJIMR, IIM Mumbai, JBIMS and IIM Nagpur. They sit among the top MBA colleges in Maharashtra 2026, provided you read the correct programme on each card.
listLead: SIBM Pune appears on the ₹30 lakh list but not here, because the highest package we hold for it is ₹34 LPA. On this page, watch the JBIMS and IIT Bombay cards, which can show a non-flagship programme.
snapshot: Across these {{colleges}} colleges, the median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, from placement years {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
Recorded averages run from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The highest single figure we hold is {{highestMax}}, on JBIMS's MMS Finance row for 2024.
Five colleges are listed as private and three as public. CAT is linked to all eight in our records, with MAH MBA CET also appearing at one college.
firstCollegesLead: In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Mumbai is 6th, IIT Bombay is 14th, SPJIMR is 20th and IIM Nagpur is 25th. SPJIMR's 2024 PGDM Finance row shows an average of ₹33 LPA and a highest of ₹81 LPA in our file.
JBIMS's official Final Placement Report for the MMS batch of 2023-25 lists a mean CTC of ₹26.48 LPA and a highest of ₹55.60 LPA. That is the row now shown on the card.

sections.heading: How this ₹50 lakh list differs from the ₹30 lakh Maharashtra list
paragraphs: The sister article with a ₹30 lakh cut includes SIBM Pune, SIIB, NMIMS and a few older records. This tighter cut keeps the eight colleges whose highest package in our file is at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh, with years from 2022 to 2024.

compare.heading: How to compare MBA colleges in Maharashtra with ₹50 lakh highest package
paragraphs: A highest package of ₹50 lakh or more is still one offer. Use the average, the official rank and the programme name to compare these eight colleges.

faqs.question: Which MBA colleges in Maharashtra with ₹50 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} colleges: IIT Bombay, SPJIMR, BIMM, JBIMS, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IBS Mumbai and IBS Pune. Each has a highest-package record of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh in our file.

faqs.question: What average packages do these colleges report?
faqs.answer: The median recorded average is {{pkgMedian}}, with recorded averages from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. These figures come from placement years {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}} and are historical, not promises.

faqs.question: Why is SIBM Pune missing from this list?
faqs.answer: The highest package we hold for SIBM Pune is ₹34 LPA, which is below this ₹{{threshold}} lakh cut. SIBM Pune is still 11th in the NIRF 2025 Management ranking and appears on the ₹30 lakh list.

faqs.question: Which JBIMS figures should I use?
faqs.answer: Use the official MMS 2023-25 report, which lists a mean CTC of ₹26.48 LPA and a highest of ₹55.60 LPA. An older MHRD card with ₹1 LPA and ₹4 LPA is no longer used.

faqs.question: What are the official NIRF 2025 ranks here?
faqs.answer: IIM Mumbai is 6th, IIT Bombay is 14th, SPJIMR is 20th and IIM Nagpur is 25th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. BIMM and the IBS campuses are not in that top 100.
